title: Rooks: open files and the 7th rank

steps.prompt: Rooks need open files: files with no pawns on them. From an open file a rook can invade the enemy camp.
steps.explanation: Rooks need open files: files with no pawns on them. From an open file a rook can invade the enemy camp.

steps.prompt: Put your rook on an open file.
steps.explanation: The d- and e-files have no pawns: perfect for a rook.
steps.hint: Find a file with no pawns at all.

steps.prompt: Invade: put the rook on the 7th rank.
steps.explanation: Rd7: the rook attacks the pawns on b7 and f7 from behind.
steps.hint: Go all the way up the open file.

steps.prompt: Why is a rook on the 7th rank so strong?
correct: It attacks pawns that cannot easily be defended
options: It attacks pawns that cannot easily be defended
steps.explanation: Pawns on their starting rank are attacked from the side, and the enemy king may be trapped too.
steps.hint: Look at the pawns on the 7th rank.
